ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C1-2,
Neighborhood Commercial District; C1-3, Neighborhood Commercial District; RT-4,
Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District; and RM-5, Residential Multi-Unit
Districts symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 2-I in the area bound by:

      South Sacramento Boulevard; the alley next south of and parallel West Fifth Avenue;
      South Troy Street; West Fifth Avenue; a line 211.65 feet east of the intersection of South
      Kedzie Avenue and West Fifth Avenue as measured along the north right-of-way line of
      West Fifth Avenue; the public alley next north of and parallel to West Fifth Avenue; the
      alley next west of and parallel to South Albany Avenue; West Fifth Avenue; South
      Albany Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel to West Fifth Avenue; South Whipple
      Street; and West Fifth Avenue,

to those of a B2-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          ____________________________
                                                          Jason C. Ervin
                                                          Alderman, 28th Ward




Common Address:
3001 – 3127 W. Fifth Avenue
3064 – 3134 W. Fifth Avenue
